description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding three mana of any color a land you control can produce.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Incubation Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {0}, untapping it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Incubation Druid
uses.cardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it
